summary: Keep bounded partial CLI evidence in failed MCP tools and advertise variadic comparison arguments.
reason: Pitch comparisons emit valid partial facts before a nonzero exit; discarding stdout hides those facts from MCP clients. Captured or serialized overflow must remain a labeled preview.
validated_outcome: Observable failed-child adapter and real Nap partial comparison retain bounded facts, failure context and isError; opaque/oversize/UTF-8/escaping cases remain previews within the complete result budget.
